newsitem.title: USA: Telmex board to recommend cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Telmex board to recommend cash dividend.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico SA de CV said on Wednesday its board decided to recommend to the upcoming meeting of shareholders that Telmex declare a cash dividend of $0.525 pesos per share of out 1996 earnings to holders of AA shares, A shares and L shares.
The dividend was expected to be made in three equal payments of $0.175 pesos per share starting since June 19, September 18 and December 18, 1997, the company said.
In 1996, Telmex paid a cash dividend totalling $0.35 pesos per share, the company said.
The annual meeting would be held on April 29 and the record date for the meeting would be March 21, the company said.
